limitations: Diagnostic marker overhead is included; compare separately against uninstrumented Undo.

GPU query sum measures queued draw batches, not UI display latency or network ACK. Task-end closes prevent measuring inter-frame idle waits; command-submission bubbles within one task can still be included.
No shader/pixel change; no gl.finish/readPixels; current program batches may include non-draw GPU commands.
No canonical cross-device determinism claim. Max-batch truncation, disjoint or timeout makes coverage incomplete.
Nested CPU buckets overlap; do not sum. GPU program batches are aggregate, not per-op GPU timings. Per-op draws count submission only.
Transparent wrappers add overhead. Longtasks availability must be checked. Initial log count0 is a necessary pre-hydration check.
GPU timer stop/poll occurs after target-ready and before oracle; no readPixels/gl.finish during measurement.
